entities.summary: Qin Shi Huang, a notable figure in the history of China, associated with Qin and Han Dynasties (221 BCE–206 BCE). Preceded by Qin Shi Huang unifies China and becomes the First Emperor. Their legacy influenced Construction of the Terracotta Army to guard the emperor's tomb and Emperor Wu adopts Confucianism as the state ideology.
